sections.title: Lab call screen checks
sections.what: Checks the moment's context and leverage display, confirms the answer stays hidden until locking, drives the option and confidence controls by keyboard, and confirms the lock sends the right value and disables the choices.
sections.why: Covers the core commitment step, including the rule that the answer is not shown early.
sections.watch_out: The lock request is faked, so a break in the real save path would not appear here.

summary: Browser test of one decision moment in the Lab: the context shows, the answer stays hidden before locking, the keyboard can pick an option and set confidence, and Lock sends the right value.
purpose: Confirms the core call screen works by keyboard and does not reveal the answer early.
why: Revealing the outcome before a user commits would make the Lab pointless, so this guard matters.
how: It opens the Lab, follows the first moment, and checks the ticket shows overs, required rate, runs needed and a leverage meter. It checks the page source does not contain the hidden win-chance or winner fields. It selects the first option with the keyboard, raises confidence from 60 to 63 with arrow keys, intercepts the lock request so nothing is saved, clicks Lock, and checks the sent confidence is 0.63. It then runs an accessibility check.
inputs: The Lab page and its first moment. The lock request is intercepted and answered by the test.
outputs: Pass or fail for the context, the hidden answer, keyboard controls, the sent value and accessibility.
risks: The intercepted request means the real save path is not exercised here, and the hidden-field check is a text search that could miss a renamed field.
debug: If the sent value is wrong, check the conversion from the slider scale to the fraction. If the hidden answer appears, check what the page includes before locking.
